svg.aria-label: Lifecycle of a user session on AgentCore Runtime. The first call starts a session from a prepared snapshot in 1.4 to 1.9 seconds. After 120 seconds idle, or a StopRuntimeSession call that takes 3.1 to 3.9 seconds, the session stops and only session storage is kept. The next call resumes it in 1.4 to 1.9 seconds. After a runtime version update, the next restart starts with an empty /mnt/data, and the first call on the new version took 16.4 seconds.
